title: A grin that answers someone, around 2 months
summary: The milestone sheet says most children answer chatting, or a grin, with a grin of their own by about 2 months.
body: Someone speaks, or offers a grin, and the child smiles back. That exchange is the 2-month social item on the milestone sheet. The sheet counts an item when at least three quarters of children do it, and it says the leaflet is not a validated screen. A child without this reply yet is not called ill here. The ages are the United States list.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports the social/emotional milestone 'Smiles when you talk to or smile at her', the 75 percent definition, and the screening-tool sentence.
